kn_official.method: Exploratory new harness; KN official UI Start, real rAF/default 4ms warp wall clock, manager.update synchronous body only, 10 warmup/60 measured/3 fresh browsers. Freeze subsequent VM updates only AFTER final measured update. No per-block observer, no forced GC, no runtime/domain/config/time/random override.
limitations: No historical official KN seven-probe timing baseline exists; this is not a same-method historical retest.
Default wall-clock scheduling may complete unequal work per update; no cross-runtime speed ratios.
Input project version is not independent runtime version authentication; require recorded official bundle hashes.
